notes.title: ARENA UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Ver 1.0.4
ARENA UPDATE!

https://i.imgur.com/q9oL1xl.png

Are you ready for a new challenge? The ARENA is now open!!

A new portal has appeared in Waifu Island, it will only activate once you unlocked all playable waifus (except Rika).

https://i.imgur.com/sHQDPOe.jpg


The ARENA is a difficult challenge for the most advanced players. 
Can you defeat 20 waves of WAIFUS? If you can you will have the honor to meet the ARENA queen Kagura.
You can also play on the arena map to unlock gallery pictures faster!

https://i.imgur.com/KvqE18g.jpg

Changelog:
-Added new area, the ARENA.
-Added new game mode.
-Added new boss Waifu.
-Added new playable character.
-Added new character's gallery.
-Minor fixes.

notes.title: Rika Update
notes.notes:
Ver 1.0.3

RIKA UPDATE!

https://i.imgur.com/aeJFHAy.png

A new enemy has appeared in Waifu Island...
Reach a combo of x69 to make the new enemy appear!

Also press M to open the Minimap! This can help you find your new rival.

https://i.imgur.com/zWIxPNT.png

Changelog:
-Added new boss enemy.
-Added new playable character.
-Added new character's gallery.
-Added minimap.
-Now selecting the already selected character in character select doesn't stop the combo counter.
-Added character names in gallery.
-Adjusted some environment collisions.
-Improved performance on main menu.
-Minor fixes.
